scope_limit: Software-only validation of the proposed 26-bit profile; it is not evidence of physical RFID reader or commercial-card compatibility.
Correctness applies to the deterministic in-memory repository and logical floors 1-16, not a deployed access database.
The boundaries are deterministic simulated milliseconds and do not measure host, electrical-output, or elevator timing.
Recovery evidence covers deterministic software state and injected logging failures, not hardware reliability, field reliability, or safety certification.

Mixed timing measures Controller.submit; lookup timing measures the public repository method; authorization timing measures the public authorization function. All values are host-software observations; raw per-call samples are unavailable. No real-time, hardware, database-server, constant-time, or asymptotic result is established.
These are deterministic software scenarios with logical reader labels and outputs, not physical elevator journeys or operational trials.
Robustness is bounded to specified software inputs and failure injection; it is not field-reliability or adversarial-security evidence.
